_header.title: Cone weight classification — acceptance fixture
_header.rule: shared/src/domain/classification.ts — (1) no weight or implausible -> unknown; (2) scale bit 0 -> rejected; (3) no limits in force at the reading's own time -> unknown; (4) else low / high / within by those limits, inclusive at both ends.
_header.disagreement: When the scale passed a cone the product tolerance would not, the state is low/high and scalePassed stays true so both facts are shown. When the scale rejected a cone the tolerance would accept, the state is rejected. Which judgement governs is a clarification for IFL; this is the developer's rule until they answer.
_header.plausibility: Every case uses the plausibility window 1500-2100 g (the developer's measured defaults on file in sms.plausibility_rule; not yet confirmed by IFL).
_header.limits: Unless a case says otherwise, the limits in force are setpoint 1960 g, -30 g / +30 g, i.e. 1930-1990 g inclusive.

cases.why: on the setpoint, scale passed
exactly on the lower limit is within (inclusive)
exactly on the upper limit is within (inclusive)
1 g under the lower limit
1 g over the upper limit
1 g inside the lower limit
1 g inside the upper limit
half a gram under the lower limit is still low, not rounded to within
scale rejected although the weight is inside the tolerance — the scale's bit governs 'rejected'
scale rejected and the weight is also under the limits — rejected, not low
scale rejected and the weight is also over the limits — rejected, not high
scale passed but 30 g under the product's lower limit — the disagreement case; both facts kept
scale passed but 30 g over the product's upper limit — the disagreement case
no product recorded at the reading's time — nothing to judge against
no limits: a light-looking weight is not called low without a tolerance
the scale's bit needs no product limits to mean rejected
no weight recorded
below the plausibility floor — a scale fault seen in the real data, not a light cone
above the plausibility ceiling — the 2200-2354 g fault population, not a heavy cone
implausible beats rejected: a non-reading is not a rejected cone either
exactly on the plausibility floor is plausible (inclusive) and judged
exactly on the plausibility ceiling is plausible (inclusive) and judged
asymmetric offsets (1920-2000 g) — inside
no scale bit recorded: judged by the product alone, scalePassed stays null
